ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/off-white pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the lateral lobes, bisected by a central low-intensity (black) vertical corridor. A distinct high-contrast yellowish-tan elliptical blob is localized in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe, flanked by smaller black mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 80 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-pointing convex curve along the distal margins of the lobes, terminating in sharp, calcified lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Scattered smaller white circular points are visible against the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the high-intensity white regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-tan diatom film accumulation on the medial portion of the right lobe; irregular, non-uniform jaggedness along the trailing edge indicates historical mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific irregular indentation or 'notch' located on the superior-outer margin of the right lobe, distinct from standard serrations.
